cookSteps.description: Thinly slice scallions; finely chop cilantro
ingredients: 4 scallions, white and light green parts
2 tbsp cilantro (leaves and stems), plus more to garnish

cookSteps.description: In a small pot over medium-low, sizzle oil, scallions, chile flakes, and cilantro until the oil turns orange
Take off the heat, let cool a bit, and season with salt and pepper
Stir labne with lemon juice, season, and spoon into a serving bowl
Swirl in the scallion oil; top with extra cilantro
